name: reharm
description: re:Harmoniz — a research loop that settles decisions. A scope declares the decisions it exists to settle; claims are the branches under them. Sources become claims only where a decision rests on them, verification depth follows what rests on each node (3 refuters if load-bearing, 1 lens if supporting, none if unbound), and branches nothing is waiting on are pruned — a status distinct from deprecated, because "nothing depends on this" is not "this was wrong". Progress is counted in decisions settled and branches pruned. Ships 7 skills: root (scaffold + decision-gated seeding), reharmonization (5-phase session serving one decision), modal-interchange (cross-scope mashup), critique (adjudication + pruning), pushing (read-only next-step advisor), experiment-design (field-experiment pre-registration), ensemble (answer synthesis into citable deliverables). Also ships an opt-in autonomous loop template (templates/loop.md) that drives these skills unattended via the native /loop command — and refuses to run a scope with no open decision — plus loop-setup, a wizard that configures and starts that loop in one command. Self-contained: web search uses native tools; frontier scoring and wiki lint ship as stdlib scripts.
